identity.title: [v0.92][WP-01][readiness] Complete design-time cards for every milestone issue

values.goal: Make all 58 v0.92 execution issues genuinely design-time ready before milestone implementation begins, including #5862-#5878 and excluding externally owned #5861.
values.required_outcome: Every child has source-grounded approved design, issue-specific SIP/STP/SPP, truthful VPP/SRP/SOR, typed validation, and a released preparation claim.
declared_scope: .csdlc issue-local readiness surfaces for the 58 execution issues in six umbrellas: #5854 through #5858 plus WP-04 implementation umbrella #5862
Issue #5861 is externally owned and excluded
authority_boundary: Issue 5860 owns readiness preparation and integration only
Child issues retain all product implementation and proof authority
Sprint umbrellas retain coordination and integrated review authority
operator_constraints: Do not edit tracked work on main
Use typed C-SDLC v2 card and lifecycle operations
Use six disjoint sprint preparation lanes; #5855 owns WP-04 architecture and security gating while #5862 owns WP-04 implementation coordination
Do not start #5862 implementation until #5821 is terminal
